'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022 Russian mobilization]]
***The [[Russia]]n [[Federal Assembly (Russia)|Federal Assembly]] amends its [[mobilization]] laws, raising the age limits for [[Conscription in Russia|conscription]] to 70 years old from 65 for the [[Army ranks and insignia of the Russian Federation|highest-ranking officers]] of the [[Russian Armed Forces|armed forces]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-extends-eligibility-military-call-up-by-least-five-years-2023-07-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[President of the Philippines|Philippine president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] signs into law the [[Maharlika Investment Fund]], the country's [[sovereign wealth fund]], amid warnings and opposition from various sectors. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-07-18/philippines-marcos-signs-sovereign-wealth-fund-bill-into-law (Bloomberg)]
*[[Spain]]'s [[Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia|competition commission]] fines American [[Big Tech|technology companies]] [[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] and [[Apple Inc.|Apple]] {{Euro|194 million|link=yes}} ([[United States dollar|US$]]218 million) for allegedly agreeing to [[Anti-competitive practices|restrict competition]] by having [[Timeline of Apple Inc. products|Apple products]] sold directly through Amazon's platforms and limiting opportunities for [[Third-party logistics|third-party retailers]]. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-apple-amazon-antitrust-fine-4147c0374681f90746b64fa54039b601 (AP)]
*The [[Bank of Japan]] governor [[Kazuo Ueda]] says that the bank's loose [[Monetary and fiscal policy of Japan|monetary policy]] will continue, and since "our assumption ... is unchanged, our overall narrative on monetary policy remains unchanged." [https://www.reuters.com/markets/asia/bojs-ueda-still-some-distance-sustainably-hit-2-inflation-target-2023-07-18/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 North India floods]]
**Eight people are killed and more than 115,000 people are [[internally displaced person|displaced]] after heavy flooding in [[Assam]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/flash-floods-indian-state-assam-kill-eight-2023-07-18/ (Reuters)]
*An elderly woman is killed and two other people are injured when a three-story residential building partially collapses in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1235/505019/Egypt/Urban--Transport/An-elderly-woman-killed-in-a-Cairo-building;s-part.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 European heat waves]]
**The [[European Union]]'s [[Directorate-General for European Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations#Emergency Response Coordination Centre (ERCC)|emergency response coordination centre]] issues red alerts due to [[extreme heat]] in [[Croatia]], [[Montenegro]], [[Serbia]], most of [[Italy]], and parts of [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and [[Spain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/wmo-warns-risk-heart-attacks-deaths-heatwave-intensifies-2023-07-18/ (Reuters)]
*An [[Disease outbreak|outbreak]] of [[dengue fever]] infects over 200 people in a rural region of Egypt's [[Qena Governorate]]. The patients are said to all have mild to moderate symptoms, which include fatigue and [[fever]]. [https://www.egyptindependent.com/health-ministry-investigates-dengue-fever-outbreak-in-qena/ (Egyptian Independent)]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea–United States relations]], [[List of American and British defectors in the Korean War|American military defectors to North Korea]]
**An [[United States Armed Forces|American soldier]] facing disciplinary action flees across the [[Military Demarcation Line|inter-Korean border]] into [[North Korea]] and is believed to be in North Korean custody. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-national-crosses-military-demarcation-line-into-north-korea-yonhap-2023-07-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Korea–United States relations]]
**The [[USS Kentucky (SSBN-737)|USS ''Kentucky'']] is deployed to [[Busan]], [[South Korea]], marking the first time that a [[Ballistic missile submarine|nuclear-capable missile submarine]] has been deployed to the region since 1981. [https://www.navytimes.com/news/your-navy/2023/07/18/us-deploys-nuclear-armed-submarine-to-south-korea/ (Navy Times)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Michigan]] [[Michigan Attorney General|Attorney General]] [[Dana Nessel]] announces charges against 16 “fake electors” for former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] in a effort to reverse president [[Joe Biden]]’s victory in [[2020 United States presidential election in Michigan|the state]] during the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 election]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2023/07/18/fake-trump-electors-charged-with-michigan-election-crimes.html (CNBC)]
*[[Philippine drug war]]
**The Appeals Chamber of the [[International Criminal Court]] rejects the appeal of the [[Philippine government]] against the resumption of the investigation of the [[war on drugs]] under [[Presidency of Rodrigo Duterte|the presidency]] of [[Rodrigo Duterte]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/07/18/asia/philippines-icc-war-on-drugs-judgment-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*An [[Judiciary of Egypt|Egyptian court]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] Christian rights activist [[Detention of Patrick Zaki| Patrick Zaki]] to three years in prison over an opinion article he wrote in 2019 about [[Persecution of Copts|discrimination against Coptic Christians]]. [https://apnews.com/article/egypt-rights-activist-italy-coptic-christians-a8f13a0f330f52ae58fd641adc59d6a8 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-66236090 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2023 in archosaur paleontology]], [[2023 in paleomammalogy]]
**In a study published in the [[Academic journal|journal]] ''[[Scientific Reports]]'', researchers present a 125-million-year-old [[fossil]] from [[central China]] depicting a [[mammalian]] ''[[Repenomamus robustus]]'' [[Predation|hunting]] a [[dinosaur]], ''[[Psittacosaurus|Psittacosaurus lujiatunensis]]'', suggesting that small mammals may have actively hunted dinosaurs, not merely [[Scavenger|scavenged]] from them. [https://apnews.com/article/mammals-eating-dinosaurs-cretaceous-af0ccd6f491e01ec779753b03568c61c (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Commonwealth Games]]
**The [[States and territories of Australia|Australian state]] of [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]] withdraws as host of the 2026 [[Commonwealth Games]] due to the increasing cost projections relative to initial estimations. [https://sports.inquirer.net/519431/commonwealth-games-in-limbo-after-australia-pulls-out-as-2026-host (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
